subject: Math
prompt: In triangle $PQR$, the measure of angle $P$ is $81°$ and the measure of angle $Q$ is $36°$. What is the measure, in degrees, of angle $R$?
explanation: The sum of the measures of the interior angles of any triangle is $180°$. Since angle $P$ measures $81°$ and angle $Q$ measures $36°$, the measure of angle $R$ is $180° - 81° - 36° = 63°$.
